title: Approximate tangent planes almost everywhere imply countable rectifiability (Simon Ch. 3, 1.6 ⇐, corrected constant; parent V13)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^P Borel with Hⁿ(M) < ∞ (Hⁿ = μHE[n]) and Q : ℝ^P → linear subspaces such that x ↦ (orthogonal projection onto Q(x)) is Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable and HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x (Q x) holds for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M. Then M is countably n-rectifiable (SimonGMT CountablyRectifiable n M).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (Q : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), MeasurableSet M → μHE[n] M ≠ ∞ → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (Q x).starProjection) (μHE[n].restrict M) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x (Q x)) → CountablyRectifiable n M
